content: Obushinganyanya bwa Nyamuzinda
Bildadi w’e Shwahi, ajà eluhya aderha, erhi:
Kàli orhanaleke okuderhaderha? Okûla kuderha ebinwa biri nka cihûsi cinene?
Ka Nyamuzinda ankahabûla olubanja, ka Nyamubâho ankagolongohya obushinganyanya?
Akabà abâna bâwe bàmugayisize, bubî bwâbo ànabahanire
Wêhe akabà oli mwêru kwêru na mushinganyanya, olongerezagye Nyamuzinda, oshenge Nyamubâho.
Kurhenga buno akushubiza omu bwîra bwâge, anashakâle enyumpa z’omushinganyanya.
Obwôrhere bwâwe burhanzi wabulola nka busha, omu kubona obôloloke bukulinzire.
Odôkereze àbâli burhanzi, oyumvîrhize bwinjà bici b’îshe bàbwîne.
Rhwêhe, injo rhwaciburhagwa, rhurhamanyiri bici, ensiku zîrhu bano igulu ko zirazûka nka cizûngu-zûngu.
Bôhe, bakuyigîriza banakubwîrize, n’akanwa kabali emurhima kakumanyisa obu burhimanya:
«k’omufinjo gunamere omurhali omu luziba? K’olushasha lwankamera buzira mîshi?
Oku luciri lurhò ntyâla, ciru ankabà ntâye olutwire, lwo lurhanga ebindi byâsi okuyûma»
Abayibagira Nyamuzinda, kwo bafà ntyo, Obulangâlire bw’enkola-maligo, nabwo ko buhera ntyo.
Ebi acîkubagira, buli budodo, n’ebi alangâlira lubà lwôgo lwa lwirhangulira
Akayegemera enyumpa yâge, enakûnduke, akayisimikirakwo, enamuhongokane.
Lolà oku ayunjwîre magoba amango g’izùba, n’ebyâna byâge byanalândira omu ishwa lyâge.
Emizî yâge ezongobarhine oku ibuye, anakazidômera omûka omu karhî k’amabâle.
Lêro bamushugula halya àli, halya mwâge bamuhaba, erhi: «rhwembi ngahi?»
Lâba oku akola abolera omu njira, n’abâbo badwîrhe babêra idaho.
Nanga, Nyamuzinda arhalêkerera Omushinganyanya, arhanarhabâla enkola-maligo.
Amasheka ganashubirhûnza amarhama gâwe, n’obusîme bucîyêrekane oku kanwa kâwe.
Abashombanyi bâwe enshonyi zibabumbe, n’aha mw’enkola-maligo hashâbwe.
